title: An Unforgettable Street Art Experience – A Must-Do in Barcelona!
text:
Absolutely recommend this amazing graffiti workshop!

Yasmina, our artist and guide, was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate. She introduced us to the world of street art, shared fascinating stories about different artists, explained various spraying techniques, and gave us a crash course in using spray cans.

The best part? Getting to create our own graffiti right on the street, surrounded by incredible street art!

Such a fun, unique, and unforgettable experience. Definitely one of the highlights of our trip and absolutely worth every penny! Highly recommend!
author: christinehS7489LD

title: Highly recommended - great trip!
text:
We did our tour on a Sunday morning and Luke was an excellent guide, very easy going but also knows the street art to an extremely high level. He kept it fun, informative and engaging throughout for me, my wife and teenage sons. We finished with a studio tour with an artist named Ashwan. Not only is Ashwan a great artist but he is also very engaging and accommodating and made us all feel at ease and not at all rushed.
I highly recommend this company and tour!
author: CPJ77

title: Amazing Street Art session
text: A discovery of Barcelona street art with Juan that was just magical. Like what even with a little rain, this activity remains great. We feasted and we were able to leave our mark in Barcelona in a more than modest style but we left very proud 😁.
author: tsaolat

title: Well worth your time.
text:
Kat is wonderful host with a great understanding of the city and what makes it tick. The tour took us places we were unlikely to discover and each location had some wonderful and interesting pieces to look at and discuss. Extremely reasonable price wise too for a couple of hours of someone's time. Finished off at a couple of galleries tucked away to peruse. No hard sell. No obligations. Just cool places and cool people. Better than churches.
Dan and Emma. X
author: Emmakh101

title: Best activities in Barcelona
text:
The activity was so much fun. Katherine is our guide and she is knowledgeable and passionate about the painting and city. We did it at noon but with lots of shadow and breeze, vey chill. 
For a foreigner as well as a zero experience of street painting, she really help us to really enjoy this morning with lots of satisfaction. Thanks you Kat!
author: patrickwC8484AI

title: Fantastic and Unique Experience!
text: This activity was the highlight of our trip. We loved that it was a hands-on experience creating street art. Juan was very informative as we made our brief walk to the art park. We learned about several murals in the city, and about the history of graffiti in general. He is a true artist and not just someone they hire to teach a few skills. He helped us bring a real piece of work to the streets of Barcelona!  I highly recommend this trip if you love to create. My two teen boys (15, 16) truly had a great time. I loved that we weren’t standing in line with all the other tourists-it felt special/
author: Jennifer_C

title: Fun in the sun and GRAFFITI
text: Had a great time with my teenage daughter taking part in a private street art tour of the streets of BCN, finishing off with a graffiti session on an impressive wall at the Tres Chimeneas. Our guide Juan was super cool! Great activity for those looking for a bit of original and creative fun.
author: enricobB5848FQ

title: Best art tour in Barcelona!
text: Amazing tour for art lover and an immersive city tour with deep insights into its culture, history, societal reflections that are writing on the walls. The studio visit is an absolute highlight! A 5 star experience 100%!
author: Shiyi X

title: A Must In Barcelona!
text: A fabulous tour around the old town of Barcelona, exploring art galleries, street art and architecture along the way. Luke was a great tour guide with lots of info and made us feel really welcome. Would highly recommended this to any art lovers.
author: W9665PAjackt

title: Great time with our teenagers!
text: This was both magical, fun and super cool for the whole family. Beeing able to do street art with one of the foremost street art artists was a blast! The teenagers in the family loved the grafitti workshop and ending up with an awsome grafitti art piece was super! Thank you so much for the laughs, knowledge and a splendid time for us all. We want to do this again!!
